A third prominent O-ring on the posterior flank shows a thicker, higher-intensity light boundary with a high-contrast transition to the dark interior.

These core concentrations are primarily distributed along the ventral-lateral margin and scattered within the gaps between the larger annular structures on the posterior half of the visible body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary macro-annuli (upper-mid C-shape, lower-mid O-shape, and posterior O-shape) form an obtuse scalene triangle.
